**LAYOUT: 5 tabbed sections, persistent header with KPI strip**

**Tab 1 — Executive Summary**

* 6 animated KPI cards: Revenue, OP Margin, LFL Growth, Total Restaurants, HEPS, Net Debt/EBITDA — each with trend arrow vs prior quarter and prior year
* FY selector (FY2023 / FY2024 / FY2025) that re-renders all charts
* Revenue + EBITDA waterfall bar chart by quarter
* "AI Narrative" panel: a paragraph of auto-generated commentary that reads the data and writes a plain-English summary of the quarter's performance

**Tab 2 — Revenue & Profitability**

* Stacked area chart: Revenue by Region (SA, SADC, AME, UK) over 12 quarters
* OP Margin line chart: Group vs SA vs SADC vs UK, with the AME loss shown as a separate negative bar underneath
* Division margin heatmap (Leading Brands / Signature / Manufacturing / Logistics / Retail across quarters — colour-coded green→red)
* AI insight callout: flags the load shedding dip in FY2024 Q2/Q3 and margin recovery

**Tab 3 — Brands & Restaurants**

* Animated line chart: SA restaurant count by brand (6 brands, each a different colour) — the Mugg & Bean growth vs Wimpy flatline is very visible
* LFL Growth dual-line chart: Leading Brands vs Signature Brands — the deceleration from 15% to sub-1% is the headline chart
* Net opens/closes per quarter: grouped bar chart
* AI insight: picks the fastest-growing and worst-performing brand and explains why

**Tab 4 — Digital & ESG**

* Three growth lines on one chart: Loyalty Members, Delivery Hubs (×10 for scale), Munch POS restaurants — the transformation arc
* ESG card trio: GHG trend (going down), Solar generation (going up), CSI investment
* Progress bars for digital KPIs vs a hypothetical target

**Tab 5 — Balance Sheet & Capital**

* Dual-axis chart: Net Debt (bar) + Net Debt/EBITDA ratio (line) — the deleveraging story
* ROCE trend line
* Logistics case volumes over time

**AI Insights Engine (throughout)**

* Each tab has a "✨ AI Analysis" button that slides open a panel with pre-generated, data-driven commentary — written as if a financial analyst just reviewed the numbers
* Insights are computed dynamically in JS (e.g., it actually calculates YoY change, picks the worst-performing region, flags inflection points) so they read as genuinely analytical, not canned
* A "Key Risks & Opportunities" section on the summary tab with bullet points the AI has flagged

**UX Polish**

* Dark/light mode toggle
* Quarter range slider to animate trends over time
* Hover tooltips on all charts with full context
* Print/export button for each chart (as PNG)
* Responsive layout
